Quests.name: You are finally awake
Quests.text: You open your eyes and take a deep breath. You can tell it's been a long time since you've seen the sun on your face. Nowhere around you seems familiar, and it's so quiet that it feels eerie. Suddenly you feel your throat burning like you just swallowed a flare. You should probably have something to drink, and the sound of a small stream lures you to the west.
Quests.done_text: You get on your knees and drink as much water as you can from the stream. You don't really care too much about the taste since the fire in your throat is now quenched.

Quests.name: Movement
Quests.text: You can move around using the [W][A][S][D] keys.

Quests.name: Interact
Quests.text: Use [LMB] to interact with your surroundings. You can drink water from the stream by clicking on it.

Quests.name: Something within
Quests.text: Well, you managed to get some water, but now you have a new set of problems. Your stomach hurts like crazy. Not sure if the water had something or you just need to eat something. You are a resourceful one, I'm sure you'll manage it.
Quests.done_text: You did it again! looks like you'll get to live for a bit longer after all. Eating raw meat was probably not the best idea, tho.
Quests.objectives: [{"type":"kill","ref":"animal_chicken","need":1,"label":"Hunt an animal"},{"type":"own","ref":"food_raw-meat","need":1,"label":"Collect meat from the dead animal"},{"type":"eat","ref":"food_raw-meat","need":1,"label":"Eat the animal's meat"}]

Quests.name: Let's be civil
Quests.text: Dirty water and raw meat is not a modern way to live. We should probably gather some materials to make a cooking station.
Quests.done_text: Good, you now have everything you need to start cooking with fire. Let's get our hands dirty!

Quests.name: Let's be civil
Quests.text:
Next step, we'll need to get some fire going. We already have everything ready. Let's get this fire started!

You can open the Build menu using the [B] key.
Quests.done_text: Now it's ready! we only need something to put on it.

Quests.name: Let's be civil
Quests.text: Let's now find what you'll need for a decent meal. The disgusting dirty water from the stream and a bit of raw meat will taste and feel much better once you cook them.
Quests.done_text: Now we are cooking!.. well, not yet.. but we're getting there
Quests.objectives: [{"type":"own","ref":"material_empty_bottle","need":1,"label":"Find an empty bottle"},{"type":"own","ref":"drink_water_dirty","need":1,"label":"Fill the empty bottle with Dirty Water on the stream"},{"type":"own","ref":"food_raw-meat","need":1,"label":"Collect raw meat from a dead animal"}]

Quests.name: Let's be civil
Quests.text:
Now we only need to find some fuel for the campfire and we'll be almost ready!

Pro tip: you can find branches laying around on the floor. Trees will drop some when you punch them.
Quests.done_text: Alright! almost done.. now we just need to set everything in place

Quests.name: Let's be civil
Quests.text: Now it's cooking time! let's use the campfire to cook that raw meat and boil that dirty water. Remember to add branches as fuel, and turn the fire on!
Quests.done_text: That's a full meal, and your stomach no longer feels weird this time. The power of science for the win!
Quests.objectives: [{"type":"interact","ref":"station_campfire","need":1,"label":"Use the campfire"},{"type":"craft","ref":"food_cooked-meat","need":1,"label":"Fuel the campfire with branches and cook raw meat"},{"type":"craft","ref":"drink_water_clean","need":1,"label":"Fuel the campfire with branches and cook dirty water"},{"type":"eat","ref":"food_cooked-meat","need":1,"label":"Eat the Cooked Meat"},{"type":"drink","ref":"drink_water_clean","need":1,"label":"Drink the Water Bottle"}]

Quests.name: Somewhere else
Quests.text: You seem to feel better already, maybe it's time you get some help. The northern exit is blocked by dead trees. A basic tool could help you get out of here.

nodes.text: Well, it's a new face here.. that doesn't happen very often! welcome to Hell's Road. Based on how you look I'm sure you'll feel right at home!

answers.text: I'd like to see what the hell you have for sale..

nodes.text: What? I'm not that kind of girl, fuck you!
